docs.text:
The first volume of Vaidya’s history of mediaeval Hindu India: the society, religion and literature of the age of Harṣa and of the Rajputs (Poona, 1921). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: History of mediæval Hindu India (being a history of India from 600 to 1200 A.D.) .. · Vaidya, Chintaman Vinayak, 1861-1938 · 1921, 448 scanned pages. Published 1921; Chintaman Vinayak Vaidya died 1938; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
